summary: Baidu Scholar in the daily feed and the PDF routes (unit B): Chinese keywords (<= 3 per project per refresh, one rotating page per day) go to Baidu with the user's key only when Baidu is on and a key is saved; new DOIs are enriched by one OpenAlex batch (PDF links, arXiv id, language, merged with the Baidu page); Baidu papers get a language from their Chinese title and abstract without writing one back; a Baidu page counts as a source (page); download_pdf asks OpenAlex once by DOI and returns ordered pages on failure; the reader offers up to three page buttons and a drop target for a PDF; paper links fall back to the Baidu page.
scope_note: Worktree baidu-scholar, unit B on top of unit A (57f0d70). Critical because new data (Chinese keywords, DOIs) leaves the machine to Baidu and OpenAlex when the user switches it on, and /api/pdf/prepare gains a field. Owner's approvals are quoted in ADR 0039; owner_approved stays false. The learning-map refresh is deliberately not wired to Baidu.

budget_impact.rationale: No model call or token. Requests to Baidu Scholar are bounded by the user's own switch and key: at most 3 keywords per project per refresh, one page each per day, answered from a 24 h cache when repeated, and a local daily cap of 40; plus one OpenAlex DOI batch per refresh.
budget_impact.after: same model cost (zero); up to 3 Baidu requests and 1 OpenAlex DOI batch per project refresh when Baidu is on

open_risks: Baidu's response shape, page numbering and page size are UNVERIFIED; the page rotation is untested against the real service.
A Baidu-only paper has no author and only a year; recommendation quality for Chinese projects has not been measured.
Independent review not done by the implementing agent; required before release.
The reader's drop target was tested with Node virtual pages only; drag-and-drop inside the desktop shell is unverified.
